stops.title: Alpine → Tucson → Fort Stockton
stops.description: I-8 to I-10 through El Paso. Two days, ~810 miles.

stops.title: Wimberley / Austin / Hill Country
stops.description: Family base. Cheatham Street Wednesday Apr 15 (sign up 8 PM, play 9). After the show, drive toward Dallas. Luckenbach picker circle if time allows.
stops.accommodation: Family base through Apr 15. Cedar Hill SP primitive ($15) or rest stop overnight on departure.

stops.title: Dallas → Bentonville, AR
stops.description: Drive north from Dallas area. Stop at Crystal Bridges Museum of American Art (free admission). ~340 miles total.
stops.accommodation: Devil's Den State Park, Loop A ($12, showers).

stops.title: Bentonville → Branson, MO
stops.description: Scenic drive through the Ozarks. ~160 miles.

stops.title: Branson → Hannibal, MO
stops.description: Mark Twain Boyhood Home & Museum ($20), cave tour, Mississippi River waterfront. ~200 miles.

stops.title: Hannibal → Richmond, IN
stops.description: Gennett Records Walk of Fame, Starr-Gennett exhibit at Reid Memorial Library. Evening at Firehouse BBQ & Blues. ~330 miles.
stops.accommodation: Grandpa's Farm ($20–25, showers) or Whitewater Memorial SP ($20–27).

stops.title: Kentucky — Clark Family History
stops.description: New Castle / Somerset / Monticello area. Renfro Valley if timing works (or catch on the return leg). ~200 miles.
stops.accommodation: Fishing Creek Campground, Lake Cumberland ($22–25, showers).

stops.title: Kentucky → Wilkesboro, NC
stops.description: Cumberland Falls day stop — campground closed in 2026 but falls still open. Drive on to Wilkesboro and set up MerleFest camp. ~280 miles.

stops.title: Wilkesboro — Buffer Day
stops.description: Rest and settle in before MerleFest opens. Explore town, walk the festival grounds.

stops.title: MerleFest
stops.description: Wilkesboro, NC. Pickin' Place jams, soak in the scene.
stops.accommodation: Off-site camping (North Wilkesboro Speedway, Sewerfest, or W. Kerr Scott Reservoir fallback).

stops.title: Asheville
stops.description: 90 min from Wilkesboro. Monday open mics: One World Brewing (7:30 sign-up), Jack of the Wood (9 PM). Tuesday: White Horse Black Mountain or UpCountry Brewing. Busk downtown.

stops.title: Bristol
stops.description: Birthplace of Country Music Museum, Radio Bristol (ask about a live session), busk State Street.

stops.title: Nashville
stops.description: Full week. Commodore Grille open mics (Sun/Mon/Wed/Thu, sign up 5:45 PM). Bluebird Cafe Monday May 4 (sign up online 11:00 AM CT sharp). Music Row Freak Show Wednesday May 6. Busk East Nashville, 12 South, Five Points. Scout housing/neighborhoods. Deadlines: Golden Pick submission May 1. Rocky Mountain Folks Fest Songwriter Showcase ~May 6.
stops.accommodation: Bells Bend or Seven Points base camp.

stops.title: Nashville → Wimberley
stops.description: Two days via Little Rock. I-40 to I-30 to I-35.
stops.accommodation: Arkansas rest stop or Ozark NF overnight. Free.

stops.title: Wimberley / Austin / Hill Country
stops.description: Family base. Austin open mics. Cheatham Street Wednesday May 13. Luckenbach picker circles. Austin Songwriters Group events. Annotation work, recording, set prep for Kerrville.
stops.accommodation: Book McKinney Falls for late nights, ~$20/night.

stops.title: Cheatham Street → Kerrville
stops.description: Third Cheatham Street visit — dress rehearsal of Kerrville set. Drive to Quiet Valley Ranch (~1.5 hrs from San Marcos).

stops.title: Kerrville Folk Festival
stops.description: Quiet Valley Ranch, Kerrville, TX. Tickets purchased. Campground culture. New Folk Competition May 23–24 (attend as audience, submit for 2027). Up to 18 days.
